Ralf Schumacher finished second or third once in 2006, in the Australian Grand Prix (round 3), where he took 3rd place ([4]). In the other races, he retired at the United States Grand Prix ([1]), finished 4th in France ([2]), 9th in Germany ([3]), 6th in Hungary ([5]), and 7th in Japan ([7]). He does not appear in the top 10 of the European or British Grands Prix ([6], [8]), so those results don't show a second or third place.

ANSWER: 1
